findings.description: The wrap check was changed from `isinstance(filename, str)` to `isinstance(filename, os.PathLike)`, so a plain `str` filename is no longer wrapped in a tuple before being passed to `edit_files`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `click.edit(filename="notes.txt")`. A str is not PathLike, so `filename` stays a str and is passed to `ed.edit_files`, which iterates it character by character. The editor is then launched on single-character paths such as 'n', 'o', 't'. The user sees the wrong files opened or created instead of notes.txt, a regression from the previous behavior.
